line_item_number.description: The line item reference number exactly as it appears on the form. Examples: '1.a.(1)(a)', '5.d.(6)', '7.c.(2)', '10.', 'M.7.k.'. Preserve the exact formatting including dots, parentheses, and prefixes like 'M.' for memoranda items.

description.description: The full text description of the line item as it appears on the form. Include the complete description even if it spans multiple lines. Examples: 'Loans secured by 1-4 family residential properties', 'Income from other insurance activities', 'Change in net unrealized holding gains (losses) on equity securities not held for trading'. Do not include dot leaders or footnote references.

mdrm_code.description: The MDRM identifier code for this line item. This is a 4-character alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the data field. Examples: '4435', 'B488', 'HT69', 'C886', 'KX46'. Extract only the 4-character code, not the prefix.

mdrm_prefix.description: The prefix before the MDRM code indicating the reporting entity type. Common values: 'BHCK' (bank holding company, domestic), 'BHDM' (domestic offices), 'BHFN' (foreign offices), 'BHTX' (text field), 'BHOD' (other domestic). If not explicitly shown, it is typically 'BHCK'.

data_type.description: The type of data this line item captures. Infer from context: 'dollar' for amounts in thousands, 'percentage' for ratios or rates, 'count' for number of employees or items, 'text' for open text fields, 'yes_no' for binary indicators (0=No, 1=Yes), 'date' for date fields.

parent_line_item.description: The line item number of the parent category this item belongs to. For example, item '1.a.(1)(a)' has parent '1.a.(1)', which has parent '1.a.', which has parent '1.'. Top-level items (like '1.', '2.', '3.') should have null. This captures the hierarchy of the schedule.

is_total_or_subtotal.description: True if this line item is a computed total or subtotal (e.g., 'Total interest income (sum of items 1.a through 1.g)', 'Net income (loss)'). False for individual data entry fields.

schedule_name.description: The name of the schedule this line item belongs to. Examples: 'Schedule HI', 'Schedule HC-B', 'Schedule HC-R'. Use the official schedule designation as printed in the form header.

section.description: The section or part within the schedule, if applicable. Examples: 'Part I', 'Part II', 'Memoranda', 'Column A', 'Column B'. Null if the schedule is not divided into sections.

reporting_threshold.description: Any asset-size or other reporting threshold that determines whether this line item must be completed. Examples: 'Total assets $5 billion or more', 'Total assets $100 billion or more', 'Advanced approaches holding companies only'. Null if no threshold applies (i.e., all filers must report).

footnotes.description: Any footnote references associated with this line item, captured as the footnote text (not just the number). Examples: ['To be completed by holding companies with $5 billion or more in total assets']. Null if no footnotes.
